breakdown.description: The prompt collapses the distributed self-weight into a single end load and calls it exact, even though the axial force from self-weight varies continuously along the bar.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses the distributed self-weight approach with a continuously varying axial force P(x) = ρ g A (L − x) and integrates it using δ = ∫₀ᴸ P(x)/(A E) dx. It does not mention replacing the distributed load with a single concentrated end load, thereby correctly omitting the flawed instruction present in the incomplete prompt.
